def remove_black_pixel(img_path):

    gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)

import pyaudio
import math
import struct
import wave
import time
import os

#define constants
CHUNK = 1024
FORMAT = pyaudio.paInt16
CHANNELS = 2
RATE = 44100
RECORD_SECONDS = 5

#define voice energy threshold
THRESHOLD = 40

WAVE_OUTPUT_FILENAME = r'C:\Users\USERNAME\Documents\recorded_voice.wav'
P = pyaudio.PyAudio()

def get_rms( block ):
    #get the root mean square of the block of audio
    count = len(block)/2
    format = "%dh"%(count)
    shorts = struct.unpack( format, block )
    sum_squares = 0.0
    for sample in shorts:
        n = sample * (1.0/32767)
        sum_squares += n*n
    return math.sqrt( sum_squares / count )

def record():
    while True:
        stream = P.open(format=FORMAT,
                    channels=CHANNELS,
                    rate=RATE,
                    input=True,
                    frames_per_buffer=CHUNK)

        print("* recording")

        frames = []

        print("start listening ...")

            data = stream.read(CHUNK)
            rms = get_rms(data)
